entries: Dom Beasley is an extreme-sports enthusiast whose Franklin missions focus on parachuting and dangerous stunts.
Hao is a street racer who introduces Franklin to the Los Santos street-racing side activity.
Tonya Wiggins is a friend from Franklin's neighborhood who gives Franklin a chain of towing missions.
Barry is a marijuana activist whose Strangers & Freaks missions differ by protagonist.
Nigel is a British celebrity tourist who, with Mrs. Thornhill, gives Trevor the Vinewood Souvenirs missions.
Mrs. Thornhill is Nigel's companion in the Vinewood Souvenirs missions, obsessed with collecting items from celebrities.
Cletus Ewing is a Blaine County hunter who introduces Trevor to hunting and shooting-oriented side missions.
Mary-Ann Quinn is an intensely competitive athlete encountered by all three protagonists in separate Strangers & Freaks challenges.
Josh Bernstein is a real-estate agent whose optional Trevor missions revolve around revenge and property disputes.
Abigail Mathers is widow of a submarine explorer; Michael can help her investigate the wreck by collecting Submarine Pieces.
Peter Dreyfuss is a film director connected to the Letter Scraps mystery and the murder of Leonora Johnson.
Taliana Martinez is a skilled getaway driver who can be rescued in a random event and then hired for heists at a relatively low cut.
Patrick 'Packie' McReary is an experienced gunman from GTA IV who can be encountered in a random event and recruited for Story Mode heists.
Rickie Lukens is a Lifeinvader employee who can be hired as a low-cost hacker for heists and improves if he survives jobs.
Eddie Toh is a skilled driver available as a heist crew member with a higher cut than some alternatives.
Gustavo Mota is an experienced gunman available for heists, reliable but relatively expensive.
Michael, Trevor, and Brad rob a bank in Ludendorff, North Yankton in 2004. The robbery goes wrong and establishes the secret at the center of Michael and Trevor's later conflict.
Franklin and Lamar repossess two sports cars for Simeon, introducing Franklin, Los Santos driving, and the early repo-job storyline.
Franklin and Lamar go to Vespucci Beach to repossess a motorcycle, clash with the Vagos, and recover the bike.
Franklin breaks into Michael's Rockford Hills house to repossess Jimmy's car, but Michael surprises him and forces a confrontation with Simeon.
Michael and Franklin chase Michael's stolen yacht and rescue Jimmy, strengthening their mentor-like relationship.
Franklin, Lamar, and Chop attempt to kidnap a Ballas member named D. The mission introduces Chop as a companion.
Michael and Franklin chase Amanda's tennis coach and accidentally destroy a house owned by Martin Madrazo, creating a major debt.
Michael spends time with Jimmy at Vespucci Beach, then intervenes when he finds Tracey partying on a yacht.
Michael helps Lester sabotage Lifeinvader and kills CEO Jay Norris through an explosive prototype phone.
Franklin, Lamar, and Stretch go to a deal that turns into a Ballas ambush, revealing tensions around Stretch.
Casing the Jewel Store gta v
Michael and Lester scout Vangelico and choose the approach and crew for the Jewel Store Job.
For the loud Jewel Store approach, Michael steals police tactical rifles needed for the robbery.
For the smart Jewel Store approach, Michael steals a Bugstars exterminator van.
For the smart Jewel Store approach, Michael steals BZ gas grenades for use inside Vangelico.
The Jewel Store Job gta v
Michael and Franklin rob Vangelico with a hired crew. The chosen loud or smart approach changes the setup and execution.
Trevor learns Michael may still be alive, attacks The Lost MC, kills Johnny Klebitz, and asserts himself in Blaine County.
Trevor and Chef defend the Sandy Shores meth lab from Aztecas attackers.
Trevor and Ron attack Lost MC operations at Sandy Shores Airfield and seize their weapons-smuggling route.
Trevor attacks the O'Neil Ranch after losing a Triad drug deal and destroys the rival meth lab.
Trevor destroys more Lost MC property and travels to Los Santos with Wade to confront Michael.
Michael and Trevor reunite, then chase Lazlow after finding Tracey auditioning for the Fame or Shame TV show.
Dave Norton forces Michael to identify a body at the morgue, pulling Michael deeper into FIB work.
Michael, Franklin, and Trevor cooperate in an FIB operation to extract Ferdinand Kerimov from the IAA building.
Michael and Trevor are forced by the FIB to locate and interrogate a target in a controversial operation.
Franklin, Lamar, and Trevor go to Grove Street for a drug deal that becomes a Ballas ambush and police chase.
Did Somebody Say Yoga? gta v
Michael tries yoga with Amanda, then spends a chaotic day with Jimmy that worsens his family problems.
Trevor works at the Port of Los Santos with Wade and Floyd while scouting Merryweather cargo for a planned heist.
Trevor steals a small submarine as preparation for the Merryweather Heist.
